record.name: Supabase
record.one_liner: Supabase provides an open source Firebase alternative with a full Postgres database, auto-generated REST APIs, authentication, storage, real-time subscriptions, and edge functions.

auth.notes: Supabase uses key-auth enabled behind an API gateway and publishable/project API keys for accessing auto-generated Data REST APIs, alongside JWTs for authentication in Supabase Auth.

access.notes: Users can start building for free and create projects from the dashboard or via database.new.

api_surface.notes: Supabase provides auto-generated REST APIs using PostgREST and client libraries for multiple languages.

mcp.notes: Supabase provides an MCP server that connects AI assistants to Supabase to inspect schemas and act on projects.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials are readily obtainable by signing up, and public documentation, client SDKs, and an auto-generated REST API allow developers to start quickly.

evidence.claim: Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST, provisioned behind an API gateway with key-auth enabled.
Supabase Auth uses JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication and integrates with database features.
Users can start for free on a self-serve tier.
Supabase provides an MCP server that connects AI assistants to Supabase to inspect your schema and act on projects.
Client libraries are available in JavaScript, Flutter, C#, Swift, Kotlin, and Python, along with a Management API.
